question: What is the theme of World Oceans Day 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Wonder: Sustaining what sustains us**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Oceans Day: 8 June.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Date:** 8 June 2025

 
 
• 
 
**Location of celebration:** Nice, France

 
 
• 
 
**Occasion:** Celebrated ahead of the **2025 UN Ocean Conference**

 
 
• 
 
**Theme:** *"Wonder: Sustaining what sustains us"*

 
 
• 
 
**Designated by:** UN General Assembly through **Resolution 63/111** on **5 December 2008**

 
 
• 
 
**First proposed:** In **1992** at the **Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro**

 
 
• 
 
**Purpose:** To raise awareness about the vital role of oceans in sustaining life and the need to protect them.
